scripts.healthcheck: node -e "require('http').get('http://localhost:8082/api/v1/health', (res) => { if (res.statusCode === 200) { console.log('Backend OK'); process.exit(0); } else { console.error('Backend Unhealthy'); process.exit(1); } }).on('error', (e) => { console.error('Backend Offline:', e.message); process.exit(1); })"
